sources.note: Organisation profile added 2026-09-14; classification and headquarters from the lab's own site.

profile_text.body:
Meta AI (FAIR), also known as Facebook AI Research, is a for-profit research lab headquartered in Menlo Park, CA, USA, according to its own site. The site describes the lab's work as including the Meta Model API and a set of models it lists as Muse Image, Muse Spark, Muse Glimmer, and SAM 3, alongside open-source AI models.

The site presents these as the latest from Meta AI research. No products are tracked in the held record, and no lawsuits or MCP servers are listed for the company. The record notes a law exposure count of 281 in California.
